articles.summary: – Phase 1 clinical trial results for SL-325 demonstrated a favorable safety profile, a potentially best-in-mechanism immunogenicity profile, and durable DR3 blockade of TL1A binding, potentially enabling prolonged dosing intervals – – RECEPTIVE-CD1 Phase 2b clinical trial of SL-325 in patients with Crohn’s disease expected to initiate in the third quarter of 2026 – – Announced lead DR3 x IL-23 receptor blocking, half-life extended bispecific antibody product candidate, SL-846, with initial Phase
